simple.meaning: צֶלֶם (tselem) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a phantom , i.e. (figuratively) illusion , resemblance ; hence, a representative figure , especially an idol.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 17 times in Genesis, Numbers, 1 Samuel, 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 1:26. The surrounding contexts include family, family line, blood, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צֶלֶם (H6754) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: צֶלֶם (tselem) / H6754 is traced through Genesis 1:26, Genesis 1:27, Genesis 5:3, Genesis 9:6 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: a phantom , i.e. (figuratively) illusion , resemblance ; hence, a representative figure , especially an idol
definitions.full: H6754. tselem צֶ֫לֶם noun masculine Ezek 16:17 image (something cut out , compare מֶּסֶל ; Nö 'Schnitzbild'); — ׳צ absolute Psa 39:7 , construct Gen 1:27 +; suffix צַלְמוֺ 1:27 ; 5:3 , צַלְמֵנוּ 1:26 , צַלְמָם Psa 73:20 ; plural construct צַלְמֵי 1Sam 6:5 (twice in verse) +, suffix צְלָמָיו 2Kin 11:18 ; 2Chr 23:17 , צַלְמֵיכֶם Amos 5:26 ; — 1 images of tumours and mice (of gold) 1Sam 6:5 (twice in verse); 6:11 ; especially of heathen gods Amos 5:26 (text dubious; strike out We as gloss, compare GASm Dr), 2Kin 11:18 2Chr 23:17 (both with verb שִׁבְּרוּ ), Ezek 7:20 , so ׳צ זָכָר 16:17 (i.e. in male form, according to figurative of harlotry for idolatry); מַסֵכֹתָם צַלְמֵי Num 33:52 their molten images ; of painted pictures of men Ezek 23:14 . 2 image, likeness , of resemblance, ׳בְּצ ( בָּרָא ) עָשָׂה , of God's making man in his own image, Gen 1:26 (|| כִּדְמוּתֵנוּ ), 1:27 ; 1:27 ; 9:6 , ׳כְּצ 5:3 (|| בִּדְמוּתוֺ ; all P). 3 figurative = mere, empty, image, semblance , ׳בְּצ Psa 39:7 as ( ב essentiae) a (mere) semblance man walks about ; תִּבְזֶה צַלְמָם 73:20 thou wilt despise their semblance . צְלֵם 17 noun masculine Dan 2:31 image (see Biblical Hebrew צלם ); — absolute ׳צ 2:31 ; 3:1 ; construct ׳צ 3:19 , צֶ֫לֶם 3:5 +; emphatic צַלְמָא 2:31 +; — image 2:31 (twice in verse); 2:32 , 34 , 35 ; 3:1 10 t. 3; ׳צ אַנֶמּוֺהִי 3:19 i.e. his expression.
